confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are rough estimates from aggregator cost-of-living pages and a few guides. The sources disagree and some are dated or cover smaller towns, so I used a Matsuyama-appropriate level below Tokyo and Osaka prices. Beer, coffee, meal and cocktail anchors are medium to low confidence; the wine glass is a low-confidence estimate based on its usual relationship to beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and regional context. I did not search for or inspect live accommodation listings or booking pages.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is a mid-sized Japanese regional city (comparable to Okayama or Takamatsu) with prices below Tokyo and Osaka. Food and drink were checked against aggregated cost-of-living and price-guide figures for Japan and Matsuyama. Wine and cocktail anchors were set from beer and local price relationships, since direct local data was weak. Accommodation was estimated from general knowledge of Japanese hostel, business-hotel and mid-range hotel pricing.
